title: tracker judges --json
description: For each judge question, how often a human approved and how often rejected the items it held (DESIGN.md §2.3.2), read from every approve and reject in every item's history. Only T10 and T12 holds record questions: a T11 hold records none.

questions.description: One entry per question within a project, grouped by its text, sorted by project and then text.

ask.description: The question's text, or null for a decision recorded before tracker kept it, which is then grouped by question id.

question.description: The question's id, from the ref of the first decision counted.

held.description: The counts split by what held the item: each trigger and answer apart, so approving a disputed fail (overruling the judge) and approving a pass held by auto_verify: false (agreeing with it) aren't added together. Each decision counts once per question, however many of its matches were held.

held_as.description: disputed: a fail the agent disputed (T12). unsure: an unsure answer (T10). passed: a passing answer held because the project sets auto_verify: false (T10).
